doc: Walks the global singly-linked list headed by D_80081498. For every node whose field_1E has bit 0x8000 set, it detaches the node (func_80044A50 then func_8003FFF0), and unless the node's (now-updated) field_1E has bit 0x80 set, pushes it onto the freelist via func_80040044. The 'next' pointer for loop continuation is captured before the detach calls run (since func_8003FFF0 clears node->next).

globals.name: D_80081498
globals.decl: extern struct { Node *head; int pad[2]; } D_80081498; /* head of a global singly-linked Node list; Node = { Node *next @0x00; ...; u16 field_1E @0x1E; }; padded to >8B so hi/lo addressing is forced (matches existing decl in src/code.c used by func_80040418) */

calls: func_80040044(void *a0) -- already matched, defined in src/code.c
